apps.name: ClearPath Public Beta
apps.subtitle: Lumin AI: your academically-honest study companion
apps.localizedDescription: ClearPath is an educational platform built around Lumin AI, a study assistant that researches, explains and summarises -- and refuses to write your assignments for you. Includes tasks, grades, a calendar, class organisation and spaced-repetition flashcards.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes native Google sign-in for real this time: Capacitor's iOS bridge wasn't registering the local sign-in plugin at all (a build-config gap, not a signing issue), so "Continue with Google" failed on every device regardless of how the app was sideloaded. It's registered correctly now.
Native Google sign-in (fixes consent-screen branding + adds an account picker) and a version bump so this build installs cleanly as a distinct update.
